name: scrollcraft
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：scrollcraft。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Build a premium, scroll-driven interactive landing page for any business: a service company, a physical product, a food brand, a drink brand. Scroll becomes the timeline. Video scrubs frame by frame under the wheel, sections pin and advance, rails pan sideways, headlines assemble line by line, the page ground shifts colour as you travel, and the pointer moves things that are not scrolling.
